question:
**The sentence given below has one misspelt word. Spot the INCORRECTLY spelt word and select its correct spelling.**

Inkompetent employees of our company need to be sacked.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Incompetent**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in the incorrect placement of the letter "**k**" in th
